contract: A successful episode download emits episode_added once per stored episode with the episode's old expanded JSON (id, libraryItemId, podcastId, title, enclosure, guid, publishedAt, audioFile, size, duration) and a libraryItem object holding the expanded library item; a failed download emits none. episode_* events use SocketAuthority.emitter, which sends to every socket that has an authenticated user, without a library/permission filter; a socket that never authenticated receives nothing.
exceptions: normal, error and edge facets are covered by the listed scenarios.
force is not applicable: the event has no force/override trigger.

Upstream sends episode_* events to every authenticated user without a library or tag permission filter (SocketAuthority.emitter); a listener without access to the podcast item still receives them. That authorisation gap is deliberately not asserted because no client offers those events to a user who cannot access the item, and the packet asserts only that unauthenticated sockets receive nothing.

invariants.contract: A successful episode download emits episode_added once per stored episode with the episode's old expanded JSON (id, libraryItemId, podcastId, title, enclosure, guid, publishedAt, audioFile, size, duration) and a libraryItem object holding the expanded library item; a failed download emits none.

The event reaches every authenticated socket, including a non-admin listener that may access the library, and never reaches a socket that did not authenticate; a rejected (403) request that would trigger the event emits nothing.
